notes.title: Deathbound DLC - Accepted by Death Coming October 28th
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

[b]The Deathbound: Accepted By Death DLC[/b] launches on [b]October 28th, 2024[/b]! Step into the liminal space between Life and Death in the Deathbound DLC. Battle bosses representing the 5 stages of grief and face the ultimate showdown. Can you conquer Grief and find peace?

[previewyoutube=4aeqmcCxg-4;full][/previewyoutube]
In the [b]Deathbound: Accepted By Death DLC[/b], you will face new trials and uncover fresh mysteries as you step into the [b]Path to Death[/b] – a liminal space where the line between life and death blurs. This DLC introduces a [b]Boss Rush Challenge[/b], where you must release the great essences of five bosses representing five stages of grief – Denial, Anger, Bargaining, Depression, and Acceptance. Survive this gauntlet to unlock the final confrontation with [b]Grief – The Purifier[/b], a corrupted judge of essences and the mightiest of them all.

[h3]Key Features of the Accepted By Death DLC:[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Gauntlet of Grief: Tackle reimagined battles against the five stages of grief in an unforgiving Boss Rush. Each encounter offers new mechanics and challenges, culminating in the ultimate test against Grief – The Purifier.
[*] Essence of Power: Equip powerful new items like the Cloak of Semanthia, which enhances stamina regeneration when your health is low, or unlock the Anointed Therone skin and The Purger sword, granting an entirely new moveset to dominate your enemies.
[*] Walk the Path of Death: Unravel deeper layers of Deathbound’s lore while exploring the new Path to Death area.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.8 is now available!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/9a1c94ef3f37a62143303bb80506055b5372b125.png[/img]

We’ve just released the latest [b]patch[/b] for Deathbound, focusing on resolving the minor issues, bugs, and balancing the gameplay:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few collision problems that would prevent the player's or enemies' correct navigation.
[*] Tortured Soul Spin Attack Animation adjusted to provide reaction time for a player
[*] The player will no longer die from accidentally falling during the reveries.
[*] Iulia and Agharos dodges were balanced to be more fluid and responsive.
[*] Fixed a bug where the players were unable to use numpad to rebind actions.
[*] Updated the looks of a few doors in the game to make it clearer which doors can be opened, and which can’t.
[*] Reduced Death Soldiers and Fleshdolls dodge chance and invulnerability time.
[*] Reduced Invulnerability time from Dreaded Shadows Dodges
[*] Poise/Stagger bar reset time increased by 50%.
[*] Reduced Stagger recovery time of playable characters.
[*] Fixed a bug where enemies from Mamdile Reverie would provide XP (Reverie enemies don’t provide XP)
[*] Adjusted video settings to prevent visual glitches when anti-aliasing was set to low.
[*] Fixed some missing textures issues
[*] Fixed a small bug where the music on the main menu would be interrupted by multiple inputs.
[*] Adjusted the NPC battles between the Church of Death and Essencemancers factions at the Cathedral of Life
[/list]

Thank you all for the incredible support you've shown since the launch of Deathbound. Your feedback, opinions, and suggestions have not gone unnoticed. We are committed to working on updates, fixes, and new content to ensure the best possible experience for our players. Thank you, Fallen Warriors!

If you encounter any bugs or issues during the game, please report them via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4ZIyPPC8O-ssOqVTGVM0w0o1BGtNcWNBoBdaDFNrEqmalSg/viewform?usp=sharing][b]THIS FORM[/b][/url], on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] forums, or our [b]Discord server[/b].

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7 is here!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/9fd881c0798023fb94662d02ec0a74494ea44142.png[/img]

We have just released the [b]next patch[/b] for Deathbound, focusing on addressing the following issues, bugs, and game balance:

[list]
[*] Fixed a few visual bugs with reveries and echoes would not properly render some ethereal object properly
[*] Fixed a visual bug where lights from the Echo of the past would remain lit after the Echo was finished.
[*] Fixed a visual error with the Agharos skin hammer during Ultra Morph Strikes. 
[*] Increased Agharos' Attack Damage and Attack Weight.
[*] Removed the center screen function from the Lock-On button to avoid accidental camera turns while locking on, which could disrupt gameplay flow.
[*] Adjusted the dodges for Therone, Anna, and Haodai to improve gameplay feel and flow.
[*] Fixed a bug where keyboard key bindings would not save. Mouse button bindings are now included as well. (Rebinding movement keys will be added in a future patch)
[*] Moved the item Essence Router (which unlocks fast travel) to a position where the player can pick it up and use fast travel much earlier in the game.
[*] Greatly reduced the Freeze Tolerance of the mysterious pursuers in the Essence Labs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the caltrops barrels in the Unbearable Beast arena would not spawn caltrops.
[*] Fixed a bug where the player could get stuck between the legs and tail of the Dragon of the Deep boss.
[*] Increased Olivia's Freeze Ray Spell range and freeze power, and reduced its cast time.
[*] Increased Olivia’s Lightning Spell range and damage, and fixed a visual glitch where some walls would disappear when viewed from afar.
[*] Fixed a bug where the VFX of a boss in Higher Streets would wrongfully spawn.
[*] Made adjustments to Haodai and Olivia’s enchantment spells to prevent players from accidentally triggering a morph strike after casting them.
[*] Improved visual cues for doors that cannot be opened in the Life’s Cathedral.
[*] Improved the interaction regions for doors to make it easier to approach and open them quickly.
[*] Fixed a bug where small explosive spiders would spawn from broken eggs.
[*] Fixed a collision issue where the player could walk off the balcony of the Life’s Cathedral.
[*] Removed the stamina cost for sprinting while out of combat.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where Agharos would not properly hold his hammer. 
[*] Increased the stamina of all Playable Essences.
[*] Fixed a bug where some items would not spawn in the Life’s Cathedral courtyard.
[*] Improved the interaction regions for ladders, echoes, and other objects to make it easier to approach and interact with them.
[/list]
We would like to take a moment to thank you all for the amazing support you’ve shown since the launch of Deathbound. Your feedback, opinions, and suggestions do not go unnoticed. Rest assured, we read every comment, review, and message you send us. We will continue to work on fixes and new content to offer you the best possible experience with our soulslike. Thank you, Fallen Warriors!

If you encounter any bugs or issues during the game, please report them via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4ZIyPPC8O-ssOqVTGVM0w0o1BGtNcWNBoBdaDFNrEqmalSg/viewform?usp=sharing][b]THIS FORM[/b][/url], on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] forums, or our [b]Discord server[/b].

notes.title: New Patch Available Ver #1.1.5
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

We just released the [b]second patch[/b] for [b]Deathbound[/b]. We focused on the following issues, bugs, and balancing the game:

[list]
[*] Normal Morph Strikes now have a generous invincibility window at the beginning, like Ultra Morph Strikes to make them more reliable
[*] Nerfed Mobs from Essence Labs, Akratya’s Depths, and Life's Cathedral
[*] Slightly increased XP drop in all areas starting from Zehrimbal, Except Life's Cathedral
[*] Fixed bug where the camera sometimes unlocks the target
[*] Fixed a bug where players could get stuck inside The Holder enemy.
[*] Fixed attack hitbox issues where the player attack would go through the enemy without hitting him.
[*] Further Balance in the EIthalos fight
[*] Further Reduced HP and Damage of some enemies in Eithalos Fight
[*] Reduced Eithalos Lightning Spell Attack Weight.
[*] Balanced The Holder Roll Attack Animations to increase the tell
[*] Overall balancing of some enemies
[*] Balanced Final Boss Stats
[*] Adjusted Dragon of the Deep animations so arms and tentacles Pustules stay in melee range longer.
[*] Dragon of the Deep Total HP Reduced.
[*] Dragon of the Deep Reduced poison cloud damage
[*] Dragon of the Deep now has Increased delay between attacks while kneeling
[*] Reduced Unbearable Beast HP
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support. If you encounter any bugs or issues during the game, please report them via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc4ZIyPPC8O-ssOqVTGVM0w0o1BGtNcWNBoBdaDFNrEqmalSg/viewform?usp=sharing][b]THIS FORM[/b][/url], on the [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] forums, or on our [b]Discord server[/b].

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatible
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors,[/h3]

We have good news for all Akratya citizens! [b]Deathbound[/b] is [b]playable[/b] on [b]Steam Deck[/b], and we aim to receive the [b]Deck Verified[/b] status on [b]release day.[/b] Right now, all Fallen Warriors can play the [b]Deathbound demo[/b] on [b]Steam Deck[/b], and it’s fully compatible with Valve’s handheld device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/85e46cdaa1f4c2614e2df57773712a7f1e7fe5e7.png[/img]

We tested Deathbound on Steam Deck and were consistently satisfied with the results— the game runs smoothly, and we did not encounter any major bugs on this platform. Similar feedback was received from many members of our community who had the opportunity to play Deathbound on this device.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/6d90105d1e13a2889d405b0a7f83092bf528617a.gif[/img]

Therefore, we are aiming for [b]Deathbound [/b]to receive [b]Verified Game[/b] status on [b]Steam Deck[/b] on the release date, which is scheduled for [b]August 8th[/b].

If you have any questions or suggestions about the playability of Deathbound on the Steam Deck, join our Discord server and share them with us directly. You can also create a new thread on the Steam Community Hub with your questions or suggestions.

[url=https://bit.ly/Deathbound_Discord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/e398e0b6ec3181f4806c9e5bd04dbf157b0389a7.png[/img][/url]

notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

Lead a bloody crusade through [b]Zehrimbal Stadium[/b] and face the [b]Unbearable Beast[/b] in the brand [b]NEW demo of Deathbound[/b]! A new demo is [b]now available on Steam[/b] - test your skills in a new location, face new enemies, and confront a new boss.

[previewyoutube=JXOyRZpvCKk;full][/previewyoutube]

Forge your path through the unforgiving world of Deathbound. Embrace the innovative 4-hero soulslike party system, bind with fallen warriors found in the forbidden city of Akratya, and dynamically morph between each character seamlessly mid-combat. Execute devastating Morphstrikes with the combined power of the party and turn the tides of battle.

In the new demo, you'll find yourself in a completely new location - Zehrimbal Stadium. Travel through narrow corridors, ruined rooms, and even the pitch of the stadium, which served the Cult of Life as a bastion where they defended themselves against the Church of Death fanatics.

Face new types of enemies in Zehrimbal, and confront the Unbearable Beast - an abomination whose every move is extremely brutal and unpredictable.

notes.title: New Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Fallen Warriors...[/h3]

Refuse death and embrace Zieminal. The brand [b]new demo for Deathbound is now available on Steam[/b]. [b]PAX East attendees can stop by Booth #14085[/b] and face the Impending Truth on the show floor throughout the weekend.

[previewyoutube=HrWk9O-rlUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Deathbound is a party-based soulslike set in a callous world where Faith and Science clash. The brand new demo plunges players onto the Lower Streets of Akratya, a well-worn battleground taken over by the Church of Death and gruesome creatures. Towards the end of the road lies the Impending Truth, a callous boss born from the essencemancers’ experiments. The road ahead cannot be forged alone. You must call upon the fallen warriors of Zieminal for their ruthless crusade.

Since Steam Next Fest, we implemented crucial feedback from players, such as improved level navigation, enhanced hit collisions and combat balancing, and tutorial adjustments. Additionally, you will finally be able to go hands-on with Mamdile Ogate. Mamdile is a unique fan-favorite character who specializes in the Afro-Brazilian martial art of Capoeira.

[b]A list of all the changes can be found below:
[/b]
[list]
[*] New character added - Mamdile Ogate - Capoeira Monk 
[*] Performance Optimization 
[*] Improved combat balancing 
[*] Improved level navigation 
[*] Improved enemy placement 
[*] Bugfix of the Enemy behaviour 
[*] Adjusted tutorials 
[*] New Phylactery interaction and design  
[*] Hit collisions improvements 
[*] UI optimization and improvements  
[*] Vertical Sync and Motion Blur options added 
[*] Faster ladder interactions 
[*] Skill tree improvements 
[*] General bugfixes 
[*] Keyboard Mapping Added 
[/list]
As you await the launch of Deathbound later this year, you can begin crafting an unbreakable synergy now by [b]wishlisting Deathbound on Steam[/b] and [b]joining the official Deathbound Discord server[/b].

[url=https://discord.gg/XkKRQrG8cz][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/e398e0b6ec3181f4806c9e5bd04dbf157b0389a7.png[/img][/url]

Before you venture through the gates of Akratya, we encourage you to explore previous Community Hub's news, updates and Dev Journals. More of this will be shared soon, providing insights into the developers' work and inspiration behind the creation of Deathbound.

Follow Deathbound on [url=https://www.facebook.com/deathboundgame]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/deathboundgame]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@deathboundgame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/deathboundgame/]Instagram[/url].

notes.title: Updated Demo Available Soon!
notes.content:
Greetings, Fallen Warriors…

Refuse death and embrace the land of Zieminal – the gates to the forgotten city will be open again. The updated demo will be available on Steam and at our PAX East booth in Boston starting March 21st.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37345510/872fc4fba9dd58ab3c7e5e5d181c24db3f1ae9d8.png[/img]

You can expect several new features in the updated demo, and by far the biggest will be access to the new Fallen Warrior, beloved by our community - Mamdile Ogate. Starting March 21st, you will be able to take on play as a Capoeira Master and destroy enemies on Lower Streets using one of the most exotic martial arts.

Furthermore, in the new demo version of Deathbound, we have addressed numerous bugs identified by the community and implemented several improvements based on the feedback we've received from you on the Steam Community Hub and our Discord server. You'll receive the full list of changes next week, as we're still striving to incorporate as many of them as possible into the updated demo version of the game.
Deathbound awaits you starting March 21st. 

Solidify your synergy by wishlisting Deathbound on Steam. Develop strategies against the Impending Truth alongside other players by joining the official Deathbound Discord server.

notes.title: Deathbound Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Fallen Warriors...

The Goddesses have heard your prayers. The gates of Akratya have swung open. Deathbound awaits all of you. [b]The Deathbound demo is now available on Steam[/b]. Embark on a bloody journey through the Lower Streets of Akratya today. 

[previewyoutube=4AY_2MqmVF0;full][/previewyoutube]

Deathbound awaits your courageous spirit starting today! We invite you to plunge into the gritty lower streets, a battlefield worn by the Church of Death and nightmarish creatures. Confront the ruthless Impending Truth, a malevolent boss born from the experiments of the essencemancers. Forge alliances with fallen warriors of Zieminal to navigate this perilous crusade together.

Deathbound demo introduces five playable characters, each with their own distinctive abilities:
[list]
[*] Unleash steel prowess as Therone Guillaumen, the right hand of Goddess Death.
[*] Spearhead the fight against Death Soldiers as Iulia Tchevlaskia, a Cult of Life Freedom Fighter.
[*] Display brute force with Agharos of Meriva, the closed fist of the Archduke.
[*] Wield relentless magic as Olivia Heinz, chancellor to the King of Krulezgon.
[*] Strike from the shadows as Anna Lepus, the disenchanted assassin.
[/list]
We welcome your feedback, opinions, and suggestions. If you stumble upon any bugs in this pre-alpha demo, please report them using the provided [url=https://bit.ly/Deathbound_Demo_FeedbackForm][b]FORM[/b][/url] or on our [b]Discord server[/b].
